familyFit.summary: Three across demonstrated with rear-facing seats; your exact fit remains pending.
familyFit.testedSeats: 2021 test: two Attain More and one Achieve More in row two, tried both directions; two boosters also fitted in row three.
familyFit.buckleAccess: Independent booster-buckle clearance was not assessed.
familyFit.access: Test reported bench movement with ISOFIX restraints; confirm tether routing and both manuals. Roadside 40% split.

vehicleUpdates.servicing: Normal AU/NZ interval 12 months / 10,000 km. PHEV inverter coolant 60,000 km / 36 months; HSG belt 100,000 km / 48 months. Severe-use oil schedule 5,000 km / 6 months; ask Kia which applies.
inspection: Trial one rear-facing plus the two other restraints, checking adult driving position and each booster buckle.
Ask Kia to check this VIN for REC-005780 pretensioner and REC-005767 indicator campaign completion; campaigns are not owner-paid repair forecasts.
Request invoices for inverter coolant changes, HSG belt, brake fluid and every scheduled service. Repeated short/stop-start trips can trigger a stricter schedule.
Demonstrate an AC charge, all climate modes, engine transitions and absence of warning messages; get battery and diagnostic results.
Original MY 23 manual permits 91 RON, recommending 95 for best performance; confirm the actual car’s filler label. Later PHEV fuel guidance is separate.
If using row three, confirm airbag limitations and demonstrate a safe access routine with the restraints installed.

familyFit.summary: Related 2025 AWD GT-Line test supports mixed-facing restraints; exact MY 26 fit pending.
familyFit.testedSeats: 2025 test fitted three across row two in either direction and two in row three. Text does not identify all restraint models.
familyFit.buckleAccess: No measured booster-buckle access test was published.
familyFit.access: 2025 test: three across required removing one restraint for row-three access. Two-in-row-two layouts allowed easier access.

vehicleUpdates.servicing: Normal AU/NZ interval 12 months / 10,000 km. HSG belt 100,000 km / 48 months; HEV inverter coolant first 180,000 km / 10 years. Severe-use oil schedule 5,000 km / 6 months.
inspection: Trial one rear-facing plus the two other restraints; MY 25 related test does not confirm your MY 26 arrangement.
Check all booster buckles without moving adjacent restraints and check front occupant clearance.
If row three is occupied, test access and emergency exit with row-two restraints in place; manufacturer lists curtain airbags only in rows one/two.
Confirm actual model year and build/VIN before applying MY 26 versus MY 27 battery warranty or service menu.
Get a VIN campaign check, full service schedule and household comprehensive-insurance quote.
Ask whether repeated short/stop-start family trips require severe-use oil/HSG-belt servicing.

ownershipUpdates.serviceInterval: Normal: 12 months / 10,000 km. AU/NZ severe-use oil schedule: 6 months / 5,000 km; ask Kia about your trip pattern.
ownershipUpdates.serviceBasis: ESTIMATE — A$1,000/year at 15,000 km. MY 26 HEV AWD seven-visit caps total A$4,679/70,000 km including GST: A$668.43 per 10,000 km or A$1,002.64 per 15,000 km proportionally. Not an annual invoice. Normal schedule only; stricter use, wear and repairs need separate quotes.

sorento-phev-gtline-2021-23.serviceBasis: ESTIMATE — A$1,100/year at 15,000 km. MY 22/MY 23 PHEV seven caps total A$4,894/A$4,937 per 70,000 km including GST (A$1,048.71/A$1,057.93 per 15,000 km proportionally), rounded with an ageing/post-cap buffer. Large visits reach A$1,159/A$1,165. Obtain a VIN-specific quote including coolant/HSG belt and any severe-use work; do not double-count covered scheduled items.

sorento-phev-gtline-2021-23.basis: ESTIMATE — battery-side kWh/100 km of electric driving only. Original MY 23 brochure rounded 14 kWh × assumed 85% usable / 55 km midpoint of the original-car observed 50–60 km ×100 ≈21.6; rounded 22. Usable capacity/boundary are assumptions, not measured electrical consumption. Apply charging losses once; engine assistance can add petrol.

sorento-gtline-hev-awd-2026.basis: ESTIMATE — L/100 km planning proxy for MY 26 AWD HEV using WhichCar’s related 2025 AWD GT-Line week-long 6.9 L/100 km result. Not an exact MY 26 test; route/load and pump validation unpublished. Bounds 5.7–8.2 are illustrative sensitivity, not measured percentiles. Official MY 26 combined 5.7 remains separate.

risks.title: HEV traction battery outside cover
risks.detail: HEV only: a diagnosed battery defect/capacity issue may require pack work. The plug-in pack is a separate, larger scenario below. No failure-frequency claim is made.
risks.priceBasis: ESTIMATE — HEV ONLY: A$4,500–9,000 fitted pack planning scenario with assumed labour/GST. RAV 4 fitted new-genuine A$4,500–7,000 is the donor benchmark; add up to A$2,000 for Kia pack/platform availability. Not a Sorento quote or compatible Toyota part.
risks.warranty: Check original defect and capacity coverage, kilometre limit and service history.

risks.title: PHEV traction battery outside cover
risks.detail: PHEV only: larger plug-in pack repair/replacement after diagnosis. This is an alternative to the HEV scenario, not an additional HEV bill.
risks.priceBasis: ESTIMATE — PHEV ONLY: A$12,000–24,000 fitted pack planning scenario with assumed labour/GST. Anchor: different Outlander 18 kWh aftermarket upgrade A$14,600 incl GST; broaden roughly 0.8–1.6 times for OEM replacement and uncertain Kia sourcing. Not compatible hardware or a Kia quote.
risks.warranty: Check remaining original battery defect/capacity cover and diagnosis before funding work.

risks.title: Turbo petrol engine major work
risks.detail: Major petrol-engine work only, separate from routine servicing. Verify oil/coolant records; the planning scenario does not assert common failure or include a simultaneous gearbox replacement.
risks.priceBasis: ESTIMATE — A$5,000–12,000 for major petrol-engine repair/reconditioned replacement with assumed labour/GST. A different Hyundai Tucson 1.6T fitted engine is A$6,000–7,500; widen for Sorento hybrid integration and parts sourcing. Not a compatible-engine or transmission quote.
risks.warranty: Covered manufacturing-defect repairs are conditional; routine service and normal wear remain payable.

risks.title: PHEV charging electronics
risks.detail: For plug-in variants, test an AC charge and inspect inlet/cable operation before purchase. Charging hardware is an additional possible repair item; no failure frequency is established.
risks.priceBasis: ESTIMATE — PHEV ONLY: A$2,000–6,000 for charging-electronics/inlet repair or replacement, pack excluded, assuming labour/GST. Toyota/Lexus inverter A$1,000–2,500 is a power-electronics cost analogue; double and round for a different onboard charger, fitment and uncertain Kia supply. Not identical hardware or a quote.
risks.warranty: Confirm exact component cover and fault cause; accident/misuse and wear exclusions can apply.

risks.title: 2022 (P)HEV turn-indicator recall
risks.detail: REC-005767 / campaign 231070 explicitly includes selected 2022 MQ 4 (P)HEV Sorento VINs. Turn indicators may not illuminate; the official remedy is a free multi-function-switch software update.
risks.priceBasis: A$0 for the official VIN-applicable recall remedy. This is rectification of an identified campaign, not a future owner-paid replacement quote.
risks.warranty: Check the VIN and campaign completion with the Australian manufacturer; official recall rectification is separate from ordinary warranty expiry.

risks.title: 2025 instrument-cluster campaign — check build/VIN
risks.detail: REC-006557 includes selected 2025 MQ 4 Sorento and other Kia VINs. A blank/slow instrument cluster can hide speed and warnings. This does not establish applicability to the older 2021–2023 PHEV or every MY 26 HEV; ask Kia about the exact build/VIN.
risks.priceBasis: A$0 for the official VIN-applicable recall remedy. This is rectification of an identified campaign, not a future owner-paid replacement quote.
risks.warranty: Check the VIN and campaign completion with the Australian manufacturer; official recall rectification is separate from ordinary warranty expiry.

risks.title: HEV/PHEV seatbelt pretensioner recall — selected 2020–22 VINs
risks.detail: REC-005780 / campaign 231073 concerns 167 selected HEV/PHEV Sorentos. The pretensioner inflator cap can break during deployment and release metal fragments. Check the exact VIN and completed remedy; this does not establish a recurring annual owner-paid failure.
risks.priceBasis: A$0 for the official VIN-applicable recall repair; no out-of-pocket component quote or annual failure rate is implied.
risks.warranty: Official recall remedy is free; confirm campaign completion with Kia.

expertReviews.scope: Related facelift AWD benchmark for the dashboard MY 26 HEV; not an exact model-year test.

negativeThemes: Third row and its access are compromised.

fuelUpdates.basis: Original Australian MY 23 manual p 2-2 recommends 95 RON for best performance but explicitly permits 91–94; period brochure says regular unleaded. Use 91 as original-generation planning, not later PHEV 95 guidance; confirm the actual used car’s filler label, especially 2021–22.

audit.summary: Sorento mixed-facing fit is well supported, with useful driver-clearance evidence. Added pretensioner recall, original fuel-grade clarification, exact fluid/belt schedule and related HEV real-use planning; retained honest gaps on repair averages and insurance.

items.finding: Original PHEV sample remains 3 cars: A$49,990–54,990 DAP, median A$52,499, 35,432–49,985 km across QLD/VIC. MY 26-declared HEV is one QLD new-car observation at A$79,190 DAP; seller model year/VIN conflict remains. Sold and ambiguous cars excluded.

Keep original PHEV 68 km WLTP, 3.3 kW AC and 6.7 L/100 km minimum-charge road result separate from MY 26 HEV 5.7 ADR. New HEV planning 6.9 uses a related AWD test, not exact MY 26 observation. Period original PHEV manual permits 91 RON; later PHEV 95 guidance is separate.

Both tests support mixed-facing arrangements and publish adult clearance. Exact PHEV evidence is stronger than the related-year HEV evidence. Booster buckles remain unknown; third-row curtain-airbag coverage is absent.

Private-use 7 years / unlimited km transfers; HV components 7 years / 150,000 km. Both listed configurations predate MY 27’s longer battery term. Existing 70% / 7 years / 150,000 km capacity note retained; original delivery/use and booklet govern remaining cover.

Official year/drivetrain caps rechecked; keep A$1,000 HEV and A$1,100 PHEV annual planning. Manuals identify PHEV coolant 36 months / 60,000 km, HSG belt 4 years / 100,000 km and a shorter severe-use oil schedule. Do not add scheduled work twice.

Insurance rechecked 18 October 2026: A$1,700/year planning budget; A$900–3,300 sensitivity, not guaranteed quotes. Hybrid/PHEV class proxy · no GT-Line hybrid quote. No unsupported SUV loading. Your drivers, excess, insured value and cover still need a quote; CTP is separate.

Budget aftermarket audit, 18 October 2026. 235/55R19 105W replacement reference: A$900 for four fitted. Common 40,000 km life is an illustrative assumption, not model-specific wear evidence. Prices and annual savings are estimates; check the real placard and local fitted quote.

Added selected 2020–22 HEV/PHEV pretensioner recall; indicator and later cluster campaigns remain VIN-specific/free. No robust Australian annual hybrid-repair average or fitted Sorento pack quote found. A$650 HEV/A$1,100 PHEV savings remain assumptions, not expected invoices.

Mixed MQ 4 aggregate remains 3.4/5 from 31 posts; powertrain mix and experts prevent hybrid-specific reliability inference. FWD HEV has 2 posts including an expert; PHEV 1 expert. Add related AWD professional review without converting prose verdict into a numeric score.

ANCAP 2020 rating covers both, listed expiry Dec 2026; third-row airbags absent. Original PHEV towing 1,350 kg / 175 L occupied boot versus HEV 1,650 kg / 179 L. QLD four-cylinder recurring registration differs from hybrid duty category; buyer-specific CTP and interstate transfer remain separate.
